test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A man sells goods at 4% loss on cost price but he gives 20 g instead of 40 g. What is his profit or loss percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

Loss% = 4%,

b = 20 g and c = 40 g

**Concept used:**

Required profit = [(100 - a) × (c/b) -100] %

**Calculations:**

[(100 - 4) × (40/20) - 100] %

⇒ [96 × 2 - 100]%

⇒ [192 - 100]% = 92% Gain

**∴ Here (+ve) sign shows that profit is earned of 92%.**
